artifacts.summary: 3-phase, 1.5-hour verification-closeout plan for the already-built typescript extension: baseline drift re-confirmation, scratch-target deploy verification of all four merge targets with evidence record, README procedure capture plus the full gate set.

memory_candidates.content: The opencode_json merge target is gated by a .managed marker file: merge.lua's generate_opencode_json (Step 1.2) returns ok=true and writes nothing unless <target>/opencode.json.managed exists. End-to-end verification of a new extension's four merge targets via a headless scratch-target manager.load(name, {confirm=false, force=true, project_dir=SCRATCH}) must create that marker before the opencode_json target can be observed at all; a tester who does not know this will misread a correctly gated no-op as a broken merge target.
